query:
UPDATE events 
SET name = REPLACE(name, 'with 707 Halifax', 'with Tandy Leather (Dartmouth)')
WHERE name LIKE '%with 707 Halifax%' 
AND organizerName = 'Tandy Leather Halifax - 707';
